devices.config:
!
! Generated from design/group_vars and design/host_vars by design/render.yml.
! Do not edit a device config by hand: change the model and re-render.
!
version 17.9
service timestamps debug datetime msec localtime show-timezone
service timestamps log datetime msec localtime show-timezone
service password-encryption
no service pad
!
hostname dist01
!
no ip domain lookup
ip domain name campus.lab
ip name-server 10.20.0.10
!
aaa new-model
aaa authentication login default local
aaa authorization exec default local
!
! Local fallback account. Without it, 'authentication login default local'
! locks every operator out of the console the moment it is applied. The hash
! is a placeholder replaced at deploy time from the credential store.
username netadmin privilege 15 secret 9 PLACEHOLDER.RENDERED.FROM.CREDENTIAL.STORE
!
ip ssh version 2
!
ntp server 10.20.0.10
ntp server 10.20.0.11
!
logging host 10.20.0.20
logging trap informational
logging origin-id hostname
!
ip access-list standard MGMT-ACCESS
 permit 10.10.99.10
 deny   any log
!
ip routing
vtp mode transparent
!
vlan 10
 name WORKSTATION
vlan 20
 name BIOMED
vlan 30
 name GUEST
vlan 99
 name MGMT
!
spanning-tree mode rapid-pvst
spanning-tree loopguard default
spanning-tree vlan 10 priority 4096
spanning-tree vlan 99 priority 4096
spanning-tree vlan 20 priority 8192
spanning-tree vlan 30 priority 8192
!
! Guest traffic reaches the internet and nothing else on campus. The deny
! lines come from internal_prefixes, so a new campus range is covered the
! moment it is added to the model.
ip access-list extended GUEST-IN
 permit udp host 0.0.0.0 host 255.255.255.255 eq bootps
 permit udp 10.10.30.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.20.0.10 eq bootps
 permit udp 10.10.30.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.20.0.10 eq domain
 deny   ip 10.10.30.0 0.0.0.255 10.10.0.0 0.0.255.255 log
 deny   ip 10.10.30.0 0.0.0.255 10.20.0.0 0.0.255.255 log
 deny   ip 10.10.30.0 0.0.0.255 10.255.0.0 0.0.255.255 log
 permit ip 10.10.30.0 0.0.0.255 any
 deny   ip any any log
!
! Biomed devices talk to their management servers in the data centre and to
! nothing else. This is the segment an auditor asks about first.
ip access-list extended BIOMED-IN
 permit udp host 0.0.0.0 host 255.255.255.255 eq bootps
 permit udp 10.10.20.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.20.0.10 eq bootps
 permit udp 10.10.20.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.20.0.10 eq ntp
 permit tcp 10.10.20.0 0.0.0.255 10.20.0.0 0.0.0.255 eq 443
 permit tcp 10.10.20.0 0.0.0.255 10.20.0.0 0.0.0.255 eq 22
 deny   ip 10.10.20.0 0.0.0.255 10.10.0.0 0.0.255.255 log
 deny   ip 10.10.20.0 0.0.0.255 10.20.0.0 0.0.255.255 log
 deny   ip 10.10.20.0 0.0.0.255 10.255.0.0 0.0.255.255 log
 deny   ip any any log
!
! Workstations reach the data centre and the internet, but the management
! network is reachable only from the jump host.
ip access-list extended WORKSTATION-IN
 permit udp host 0.0.0.0 host 255.255.255.255 eq bootps
 permit udp 10.10.10.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.20.0.10 eq bootps
 deny   ip 10.10.10.0 0.0.0.255 10.10.99.0 0.0.0.255 log
 deny   ip 10.10.10.0 0.0.0.255 10.10.20.0 0.0.0.255 log
 permit ip 10.10.10.0 0.0.0.255 any
 deny   ip any any log
!
! No root guard on these trunks. The peer link is routed, so the only Layer 2
! path between the two distribution switches runs through the access layer:
! the secondary learns the root's superior BPDUs on exactly these ports, and
! root guard here would block the path it is meant to protect.
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/1
 description TRUNK TO ACC01 GigabitEthernet1/0/49
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30,99
 switchport nonegotiate
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/2
 description TRUNK TO ACC02 GigabitEthernet1/0/49
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30,99
 switchport nonegotiate
 no shutdown
!
interface TenGigabitEthernet1/0/2
 description L3 PEER LINK TO DIST02
 no switchport
 ip address 10.255.1.4 255.255.255.254
 ip ospf 1 area 0
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 no shutdown
!
interface TenGigabitEthernet1/0/1
 description L3 UPLINK TO CORE01 TenGigabitEthernet0/0/0
 no switchport
 ip address 10.255.1.1 255.255.255.254
 ip ospf 1 area 0
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 no shutdown
!
interface Loopback0
 description ROUTER ID
 ip address 10.255.0.2 255.255.255.255
 ip ospf 1 area 0
!
interface Vlan10
 description WORKSTATION GATEWAY
 ip address 10.10.10.2 255.255.255.0
 ip helper-address 10.20.0.10
 ip access-group WORKSTATION-IN in
 ip ospf 1 area 0
 standby version 2
 standby 10 ip 10.10.10.1
 standby 10 priority 110
 standby 10 preempt delay minimum 60
 no shutdown
!
interface Vlan20
 description BIOMED GATEWAY
 ip address 10.10.20.2 255.255.255.0
 ip helper-address 10.20.0.10
 ip access-group BIOMED-IN in
 ip ospf 1 area 0
 standby version 2
 standby 20 ip 10.10.20.1
 standby 20 priority 90
 no shutdown
!
interface Vlan30
 description GUEST GATEWAY
 ip address 10.10.30.2 255.255.255.0
 ip helper-address 10.20.0.10
 ip access-group GUEST-IN in
 ip ospf 1 area 0
 standby version 2
 standby 30 ip 10.10.30.1
 standby 30 priority 90
 no shutdown
!
interface Vlan99
 description MGMT GATEWAY
 ip address 10.10.99.2 255.255.255.0
 ip ospf 1 area 0
 standby version 2
 standby 99 ip 10.10.99.1
 standby 99 priority 110
 standby 99 preempt delay minimum 60
 no shutdown
!
router ospf 1
 router-id 10.255.0.2
 auto-cost reference-bandwidth 100000
 passive-interface default
 no passive-interface TenGigabitEthernet1/0/2
 no passive-interface TenGigabitEthernet1/0/1
!
!
banner login ^C
Authorized access only. Activity is logged and reviewed.
^C
!
line con 0
 exec-timeout 10 0
 logging synchronous
line vty 0 4
 access-class MGMT-ACCESS in
 exec-timeout 10 0
 transport input ssh
 transport output none
!
end

devices.config:
!
! Generated from design/group_vars and design/host_vars by design/render.yml.
! Do not edit a device config by hand: change the model and re-render.
!
version 17.9
service timestamps debug datetime msec localtime show-timezone
service timestamps log datetime msec localtime show-timezone
service password-encryption
no service pad
!
hostname dist02
!
no ip domain lookup
ip domain name campus.lab
ip name-server 10.20.0.10
!
aaa new-model
aaa authentication login default local
aaa authorization exec default local
!
! Local fallback account. Without it, 'authentication login default local'
! locks every operator out of the console the moment it is applied. The hash
! is a placeholder replaced at deploy time from the credential store.
username netadmin privilege 15 secret 9 PLACEHOLDER.RENDERED.FROM.CREDENTIAL.STORE
!
ip ssh version 2
!
ntp server 10.20.0.10
ntp server 10.20.0.11
!
logging host 10.20.0.20
logging trap informational
logging origin-id hostname
!
ip access-list standard MGMT-ACCESS
 permit 10.10.99.10
 deny   any log
!
ip routing
vtp mode transparent
!
vlan 10
 name WORKSTATION
vlan 20
 name BIOMED
vlan 30
 name GUEST
vlan 99
 name MGMT
!
spanning-tree mode rapid-pvst
spanning-tree loopguard default
spanning-tree vlan 20 priority 4096
spanning-tree vlan 30 priority 4096
spanning-tree vlan 10 priority 8192
spanning-tree vlan 99 priority 8192
!
! Guest traffic reaches the internet and nothing else on campus. The deny
! lines come from internal_prefixes, so a new campus range is covered the
! moment it is added to the model.
ip access-list extended GUEST-IN
 permit udp host 0.0.0.0 host 255.255.255.255 eq bootps
 permit udp 10.10.30.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.20.0.10 eq bootps
 permit udp 10.10.30.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.20.0.10 eq domain
 deny   ip 10.10.30.0 0.0.0.255 10.10.0.0 0.0.255.255 log
 deny   ip 10.10.30.0 0.0.0.255 10.20.0.0 0.0.255.255 log
 deny   ip 10.10.30.0 0.0.0.255 10.255.0.0 0.0.255.255 log
 permit ip 10.10.30.0 0.0.0.255 any
 deny   ip any any log
!
! Biomed devices talk to their management servers in the data centre and to
! nothing else. This is the segment an auditor asks about first.
ip access-list extended BIOMED-IN
 permit udp host 0.0.0.0 host 255.255.255.255 eq bootps
 permit udp 10.10.20.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.20.0.10 eq bootps
 permit udp 10.10.20.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.20.0.10 eq ntp
 permit tcp 10.10.20.0 0.0.0.255 10.20.0.0 0.0.0.255 eq 443
 permit tcp 10.10.20.0 0.0.0.255 10.20.0.0 0.0.0.255 eq 22
 deny   ip 10.10.20.0 0.0.0.255 10.10.0.0 0.0.255.255 log
 deny   ip 10.10.20.0 0.0.0.255 10.20.0.0 0.0.255.255 log
 deny   ip 10.10.20.0 0.0.0.255 10.255.0.0 0.0.255.255 log
 deny   ip any any log
!
! Workstations reach the data centre and the internet, but the management
! network is reachable only from the jump host.
ip access-list extended WORKSTATION-IN
 permit udp host 0.0.0.0 host 255.255.255.255 eq bootps
 permit udp 10.10.10.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.20.0.10 eq bootps
 deny   ip 10.10.10.0 0.0.0.255 10.10.99.0 0.0.0.255 log
 deny   ip 10.10.10.0 0.0.0.255 10.10.20.0 0.0.0.255 log
 permit ip 10.10.10.0 0.0.0.255 any
 deny   ip any any log
!
! No root guard on these trunks. The peer link is routed, so the only Layer 2
! path between the two distribution switches runs through the access layer:
! the secondary learns the root's superior BPDUs on exactly these ports, and
! root guard here would block the path it is meant to protect.
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/1
 description TRUNK TO ACC01 GigabitEthernet1/0/50
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30,99
 switchport nonegotiate
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/2
 description TRUNK TO ACC02 GigabitEthernet1/0/50
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30,99
 switchport nonegotiate
 no shutdown
!
interface TenGigabitEthernet1/0/2
 description L3 PEER LINK TO DIST01
 no switchport
 ip address 10.255.1.5 255.255.255.254
 ip ospf 1 area 0
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 no shutdown
!
interface TenGigabitEthernet1/0/1
 description L3 UPLINK TO CORE01 TenGigabitEthernet0/0/1
 no switchport
 ip address 10.255.1.3 255.255.255.254
 ip ospf 1 area 0
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 no shutdown
!
interface Loopback0
 description ROUTER ID
 ip address 10.255.0.3 255.255.255.255
 ip ospf 1 area 0
!
interface Vlan10
 description WORKSTATION GATEWAY
 ip address 10.10.10.3 255.255.255.0
 ip helper-address 10.20.0.10
 ip access-group WORKSTATION-IN in
 ip ospf 1 area 0
 standby version 2
 standby 10 ip 10.10.10.1
 standby 10 priority 90
 no shutdown
!
interface Vlan20
 description BIOMED GATEWAY
 ip address 10.10.20.3 255.255.255.0
 ip helper-address 10.20.0.10
 ip access-group BIOMED-IN in
 ip ospf 1 area 0
 standby version 2
 standby 20 ip 10.10.20.1
 standby 20 priority 110
 standby 20 preempt delay minimum 60
 no shutdown
!
interface Vlan30
 description GUEST GATEWAY
 ip address 10.10.30.3 255.255.255.0
 ip helper-address 10.20.0.10
 ip access-group GUEST-IN in
 ip ospf 1 area 0
 standby version 2
 standby 30 ip 10.10.30.1
 standby 30 priority 110
 standby 30 preempt delay minimum 60
 no shutdown
!
interface Vlan99
 description MGMT GATEWAY
 ip address 10.10.99.3 255.255.255.0
 ip ospf 1 area 0
 standby version 2
 standby 99 ip 10.10.99.1
 standby 99 priority 90
 no shutdown
!
router ospf 1
 router-id 10.255.0.3
 auto-cost reference-bandwidth 100000
 passive-interface default
 no passive-interface TenGigabitEthernet1/0/2
 no passive-interface TenGigabitEthernet1/0/1
!
!
banner login ^C
Authorized access only. Activity is logged and reviewed.
^C
!
line con 0
 exec-timeout 10 0
 logging synchronous
line vty 0 4
 access-class MGMT-ACCESS in
 exec-timeout 10 0
 transport input ssh
 transport output none
!
end
